http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02203v1.reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02203）：NEPA（Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression）挑战 'in diffusion transformers, a class label or text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step' 的现状，把'diffusion transformer 的 condition'从'static embedding reuse'推到'predicted next-embedding'：用 Transformer 预测 next continuous embedding，生成时'clean image follows noisy image'，所以 clean image embedding 是 condition 与 noisy image embedding 的 next embedding。是 inference-serving × multimodal-agent × ai-agent 的'predicted-embedding condition'趋势资产——'next-embedding prediction as diffusion condition'范式可迁移到 video / 3D diffusion 与 multimodal-to-multimodal 生成；与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × multimodal-agent 主线在'generation condition as predicted embedding'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 NEPA 架构、跨 diffusion backbone 验证、inference cost 与 static embedding baseline 对照。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。
